date_text: Thu, Nov 12th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Nov 15th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: Sydney’s own Future Brewing is taking over the taps at Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop this Thursday, and they’re bringing a massive lineup of fresh beers! We’re pouring 20 different Future Brewing beers, featuring everything from juicy hazies and hop-loaded IPAs to some seriously exciting, limited releases. Whether you’re a die-hard hophead, a craft beer explorer or just keen to discover what one of Sydney’s exciting independent breweries has been creating, this is your chance to work your way through an incredible range of Future Brewing beers, all in one place. Tap List: - Arroz - West Coast Drive - Splash - Edgy - Zuno - Kiwi Dreams - Split the F - Arvo Haze - Love Thy Neighbour - Lush Ones - Strike - Sunnies On - That Glow - Grey Giant - Wizard Soak - Skaze - Monkey Magic - Surge - Golden Curse - Silver Tongue
